channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Usman Garuba | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Usman Garuba from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Usman Garuba
item.description:
Stephen Silas on Usman Garuba:

“I was happy with what (Usman) did and he's earning minutes by the day.”

Stephen Silas on Usman Garuba, Oct 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Jae'Sean Tate on Usman Garuba
item.description:
Salman Ali:Jae’Sean Tate on Usman Garuba:

“He has a great feel for the game, he knows his angles, and he’s a tough guy to box out. He has very long arms.”

Jae'Sean Tate on Usman Garuba, Oct 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Will Weaver on Usman Garuba
item.description:
Will Weaver on Usman Garuba:

“Obviously the versatility defensively is the big draw for him, probably the overall summary of the investment in the draft…It’s not just what he brings in any individual moment, it’s how he aggregates those moments over time and gets better.”

Will Weaver on Usman Garuba, Aug 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.
